summary: A privately owned Aermotor tower in Cleburne County, near Heber Springs, registered in 2023; its build date and builder are not known.

facts.design: Aermotor tower, apparently an LS-40 model

access.note: Privately owned land; the Forest Lookouts page asks readers to respect private property rights.

events.note: Site and improvements sold into private ownership; the page dates this only to the 1990s

evidence.supports: also listed as Round Mountain (Heber Springs), Cleburne County
Aermotor tower, privately owned, appears to be an LS-40 model
evidence.quote: This Aermotor tower is privately owned. It appears to be a LS-40 model.

evidence.supports: Arkansas Forestry Commission named only as cooperator
site and improvements sold into private ownership in the 1990s
evidence.quote: 1990's: The site and improvements sold into private ownership.

evidence.supports: visitors asked to respect private property rights

corrections.why: The register lists Privately Owned under Administered by and names the Arkansas Forestry Commission only as a cooperator, so the ownership status was entered as an agency
The register says the tower is privately owned, and the Forest Lookouts page says the site was sold into private ownership in the 1990s

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder or staffing found after one web search. A commercial listing for a communications tower site near the summit could not be opened (HTTP 403), so nothing from it is used. The Forest Lookouts 1990s sale date is only a decade. The Encyclopedia of Arkansas list of fourteen NHLR lookouts does not name this tower, though the NHLR shows it registered in 2023. Public access unknown; do not encourage climbing.
